name: Discover Agent-Token Vaults
summary: List every agent-token vault in the Arcis factory registry, or find the vault for a specific token.
when_to_use: The agent wants to find or use a vault for a specific agent token, or enumerate all available vaults. Read-only.

inputs.name: asset
inputs.description: Optional: a token address to find its vault

outputs.name: vaults
outputs.description: Vault entries: address, asset, name, symbol, TVL, status
